name: Protective Asset Allocation - Europe Equity Universe + 15% Vol Target
description: Keller & Keuning PAA applied to European equities with VUTY bonds as safe asset, scaled to 15% vol overlay. Allocates to Europe equities proportionally to how many pass their 12-month SMA trend test, shifting remaining weight to VUTY bonds when European markets are in downtrend. Provides regime-aware drawdown control across European markets.
